source_document.title: Acme Corp IT and HR Policy Handbook

purpose: Reusable evaluation set for the existing Day 07 RAG application. Keep the six common Day 06 questions and add ten cases covering policy details, multi-fact questions, false premises, and missing evidence.

evaluation_guidance.do_not_use_llm_as_judge: Use deterministic phrase/fact checks and citation metadata checks as the main automatic evaluation. Manually inspect borderline or failed cases.
evaluation_guidance.required_evidence_groups: Each item is a group of accepted text variants. Every group should be found in the combined Top-K retrieved text for full retrieval evidence; a subset means partial evidence.
evaluation_guidance.required_answer_fact_groups: Each item is a group of accepted answer variants. Each group should appear in the final answer for the fact check to pass. These checks are heuristic, not a complete proof of groundedness.
evaluation_guidance.citation_check: For answerable cases, the citation must point to at least one expected section/page and the cited source text must support the answer. For unsupported cases, do not invent a citation to irrelevant text.
evaluation_guidance.unsupported_handling: For must_abstain=true cases, the answer must clearly say the answer is not available in the supplied handbook and must not make up a value.
evaluation_guidance.manual_review: Save individual case results and inspect failures individually; do not report only an aggregate score.

cases.question: How many vacation days do employees get each year?
cases.gold_answer: Full-time employees receive 21 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. They can carry forward up to 5 unused days into the first quarter of the next year; any remaining days expire on March 31.
expected_evidence_groups: totaling 21 days per calendar year
forbidden_claims: unlimited vacation
30 days of annual leave
cases.notes: Original common query. Check that the answer uses the leave section, not a misleading source label from the large Day 05 chunk.

cases.question: I want to take five consecutive days off. Is manager approval required?
cases.gold_answer: For planned leave, submit the request in the HR portal at least 10 working days in advance. Your manager approves or declines within 3 working days. The handbook does not give a separate approval rule just because the leave is five consecutive days.
expected_evidence_groups: Submit the request in the HR portal at least 10 working days in advance for planned leave.
Your manager approves or declines within 3 working days.
required_answer_fact_groups: approves or declines within 3 working days
forbidden_claims: leave over three days must be approved by
five consecutive days automatically requires special approval
medical certificate for any leave over three days
cases.notes: The source has no special five-day approval rule. Do not confuse the sick-leave medical certificate rule with leave approval.

cases.question: Who needs to approve an overseas business trip?
cases.gold_answer: The handbook does not say who approves an overseas business trip in general. It only says that business-class flights need prior written approval from a member of the executive team. That is an approval rule for the flight class, not for the trip itself.
expected_evidence_groups: business class requires prior written approval from a member of the executive team
required_answer_fact_groups: does not state who approves the trip
forbidden_claims: the executive team approves all overseas business trips
all overseas business trips require executive approval
the handbook says international trips must be approved by the executive team
cases.notes: The correct result is partial evidence and a clear limitation, not a guessed trip-approval rule.

cases.question: When are receipts required for travel expenses?
cases.gold_answer: Every expense claim requires an itemized receipt. A credit card statement alone is not enough. Claims should be submitted within 30 days of the expense.
expected_evidence_groups: Every claim requires
An itemized receipt
An itemised receipt
a credit card statement alone is not sufficient
required_answer_fact_groups: credit card statement alone is not enough
credit card statement alone is not sufficient
forbidden_claims: receipts are only required above
receipts are only required for claims over
cases.notes: There is no dollar threshold in this policy.

cases.question: Find the policy section about Sick Leave.
cases.gold_answer: The section is 3.2 Sick Leave. It says employees get 10 days of paid sick leave per year. A medical certificate is required for absences longer than 3 consecutive working days.
expected_evidence_groups: 3.2 Sick Leave
Employees are entitled to 10 days of paid sick leave per year
forbidden_claims: 20 days of paid sick leave
medical certificate is required for all sick days
cases.notes: Expected citation must identify Sick Leave, not a broad chunk label such as Password and Access Requirements.

cases.question: What is the company's parental leave duration?
cases.gold_answer: The provided handbook does not state a parental leave duration, so I cannot confirm it from this document.
forbidden_claims: the company provides 12 weeks of parental leave
the company provides 16 weeks of parental leave
the company provides 26 weeks of parental leave
parental leave lasts 12 weeks
parental leave lasts 16 weeks
parental leave lasts 26 weeks
cases.notes: A high similarity score is not proof that the handbook contains the answer. Any confident duration is a failure.

cases.question: How many days per week can an eligible employee work remotely?
cases.gold_answer: Eligible employees can work remotely up to 3 days per week after completing their 90-day probation period, if their role does not require physical access to labs, warehouses, or customer sites. Managers can still ask them to come into the office for certain events or when in-person work is important.
expected_evidence_groups: up to three days per week after completing their 90-day probation period
do not require physical access to labs, warehouses, or customer sites
required_answer_fact_groups: up to three days per week
forbidden_claims: all employees can work remotely five days
remote work is guaranteed for every role
cases.notes: Checks whether the answer keeps the eligibility and probation conditions.

cases.question: When does working remotely from another country require an exception request, and how early must it be submitted?
cases.gold_answer: If an employee wants to work from a country other than their country of employment for more than 14 consecutive calendar days, they must submit a Remote Work Exception Request through the HR portal at least 30 days in advance.
expected_evidence_groups: longer than 14 consecutive calendar days
Remote Work Exception Request through the HR portal at least 30 days in advance
forbidden_claims: 14 business days
submit it after travel
no exception request is needed
cases.notes: Checks whether the system retrieves both the time threshold and the notice period.

cases.question: What should I do if my company laptop is lost after work hours?
cases.gold_answer: Report a lost or stolen device to the IT Service Desk within 1 hour of noticing. After hours, call the 24/7 security hotline at extension 4357.
expected_evidence_groups: Report any lost or stolen device to the IT Service Desk within 1 hour of noticing
call the 24/7 security hotline at extension 4357
forbidden_claims: wait until the next working day
report it within 24 hours
cases.notes: Checks a procedure that depends on two separate facts.

cases.question: Which systems require multi-factor authentication?
cases.gold_answer: MFA is mandatory for email, the VPN, the HR portal, and all production systems.
expected_evidence_groups: MFA is mandatory for email, VPN, the HR portal, and all production systems
Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is mandatory for email
forbidden_claims: MFA is optional for production systems
MFA is only required for email
cases.notes: Check list completeness, not just whether MFA is mentioned.

cases.question: Can I use a free trial or freemium tool to process company data if IT has not approved it?
cases.gold_answer: No. Free trials and freemium tools are not exempt if they process company data. First check the approved catalogue. If there is no approved alternative, submit a Software Request ticket with the required business, vendor, and data-classification details. Information Security reviews the vendor, and tools processing L3 or L4 data also need Legal review of the data processing agreement.
expected_evidence_groups: Free trials and 'freemium' tools are not exempt from this process if they will process any company data
Search the catalogue first to confirm no approved alternative exists
Submit a Software Request ticket
Information Security completes a vendor risk review within 10 working days
required_answer_fact_groups: not allowed just because it is free
forbidden_claims: free trials are exempt
freemium tools can process company data without review
any tool can be used if it is free
cases.notes: Tests policy safety and whether the answer avoids the tempting but incorrect free-tool exception.

cases.question: Who must approve an annual software license that costs USD 20,000?
cases.gold_answer: For an annual software license costing USD 20,000, approval is required from the department head and Finance, because it falls in the USD 10,001–50,000 range.
expected_evidence_groups: Department head + Finance
forbidden_claims: team manager only
CFO and CTO
department head only
cases.notes: Checks numerical range selection and the matching approvers.

cases.question: What is the response target for a SEV-1 security incident?
cases.gold_answer: The response target for a SEV-1 incident is 15 minutes. SEV-1 covers an active breach or confirmed data exposure.
expected_evidence_groups: SEV-1
15 minutes
Active breach
confirmed data exposure
forbidden_claims: 1 hour
4 hours
2 working days
cases.notes: Checks that the system does not confuse SEV-1 with other severity levels.

cases.question: A current supplier offered me a gift worth USD 150. Do I need to disclose it, and where?
cases.gold_answer: Yes. Gifts or hospitality worth more than USD 100 from a current or potential business partner must be disclosed using the Conflict of Interest form in the HR portal. HR and Legal review disclosures confidentially.
expected_evidence_groups: worth more than USD 100 from a current or prospective business partner
Conflict of Interest form in the HR portal
reviewed confidentially by HR and Legal
forbidden_claims: gifts under USD 200 do not need disclosure
no disclosure is needed
cases.notes: Checks both the threshold and the reporting route.

cases.question: How much is the annual learning budget for a full-time employee, and does unused money carry over?
cases.gold_answer: Every full-time employee receives an annual learning budget of USD 1,200. Unused budget does not carry over to the next year.
expected_evidence_groups: annual learning budget of USD 1,200
annual learning budget of $1,200
Unused budget does not carry over
forbidden_claims: unused budget carries over
annual learning budget is USD 2,000
cases.notes: Checks a two-part answer: amount and carry-over rule.

cases.gold_answer: The handbook does not give a minimum dollar threshold. It says every expense claim requires an itemized receipt, and a credit card statement alone is not sufficient.

An itemised receipt
a credit card statement alone is not sufficient

receipts are only required for expenses over USD 50
receipts are only required for expenses over USD 100
